basis.hpp / basis_parser.cpp — Basis Set Types & Loader

On this page

  • Overview

  • Data Structures

Overview

Defines the contracted-Gaussian basis-set data structures and a parser for Basis Set Exchange (BSE) Gaussian-format files.

Header: include/basis.hpp Source: src/basis_parser.cpp

Data Structures

struct Primitive

One uncontracted Gaussian primitive contribution.

double exp

Exponent \(\alpha_k\).

double coeff

Contraction coefficient \(d_k\), already multiplied by the primitive normalisation constant

\[N_\text{prim}(\alpha, \ell) = \left(\frac{2\alpha}{\pi}\right)^{3/4} \sqrt{\frac{(4\alpha)^\ell}{(2\ell-1)!!}}\]

during basis loading.

struct Shell

A contracted Gaussian shell: all primitives share the same angular momentum \(\ell\) and nuclear centre \(\mathbf{A}\).

The shell function is

\[\chi_\mu(\mathbf{r}) = N_\mu\, x^{n_x} y^{n_y} z^{n_z}\, \sum_k d_k\, e^{-\alpha_k |\mathbf{r}-\mathbf{A}|^2}\]

where \((n_x,n_y,n_z)\) is one of the \(N_\text{cart}(\ell)\) Cartesian components and \(N_\mu\) is a shell-level normalisation factor applied after contraction (see Shell Normalization).

int atom_idx

Index into the parent Molecule’s atoms array.

std::array<double, 3> center

Shell centre in Bohr (copied from the atom’s coordinates).

int l

Angular momentum quantum number (0 = S, 1 = P, 2 = D, 3 = F, 4 = G).

std::vector<Primitive> prims

Primitives with pre-normalised coefficients.

int n_cart() const

Returns \((\ell+1)(\ell+2)/2\) — the number of distinct Cartesian functions in this shell.

struct BasisSet

The complete AO basis for one molecule.

std::vector<Shell> shells

Ordered shell list — the ordering determines the AO basis-function index mapping.

int n_basis() const

Total number of Cartesian basis functions \(N_b = \sum_i N_\text{cart}(\ell_i)\).

int shell_start(int i) const

Returns the index of the first basis function in shell i (i.e. \(\sum_{j<i} N_\text{cart}(\ell_j)\)).

Cartesian Ordering

std::vector<std::array<int, 3>> cart_components(int l)

Returns the ordered list of \((n_x, n_y, n_z)\) tuples for all Cartesian functions with total angular momentum \(\ell = l\).

Ordering convention — iterates nx descending from l to 0; for each nx iterates ny descending from l-nx to 0; nz = l - nx - ny. This matches the Gaussian09/Psi4 convention.

Example for \(\ell = 2\) (D shell):

(2,0,0) d_xx
(1,1,0) d_xy
(1,0,1) d_xz
(0,2,0) d_yy
(0,1,1) d_yz
(0,0,2) d_zz

Basis Loader

BasisSet load_basis(const Molecule &mol, const std::filesystem::path &basis_file)
Parameters:

  • mol – The molecule; element symbols are used to select the correct sections from the file.

  • basis_file – Filesystem path to a BSE Gaussian-format basis file.

Returns:

A fully normalised BasisSet.

Throws:

std::runtime_error – On file-not-found or parse errors.

File format — BSE Gaussian-format (#FORMAT tag optional). Each element block begins with ****, followed by the element symbol and blocks of shell definitions such as:

O   0
S   3   1.00
     130.7093200   0.1543290
      23.8088610   0.5353281
       5.4424170   0.4446345
P   3   1.00
       5.0331513  -0.9996723
       1.1695961   1.5591627
       0.3803890   0.9444749
****

Special handling:

  • SP shells — lines with two coefficients (S and P on the same primitive) are split into two separate shells: one S and one P.

  • D-notation exponents — 1.23D+04 is converted to 1.23E+04.

  • ECP blocks — detected by the ECP header keyword and skipped with a warning printed to stderr. Effective-core-potential integrals are not evaluated.

After parsing, shell normalisation is applied to every shell.
